author: Czco
body:
Age: 14



Timezone:bst/gmt



Do you have Teamspeak? Yes



Do you have Discord? Yes



Do you have access to a recording software? Yes




CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION 


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?


 I have loads of experience within many other minecraft servers i recently stepped down from a position on a relatively small server named VoxPopuli, on this server for the 13-15 odd players we had i had to designer prayers for the Factions side of it and Killaura / Pvp Hacks on the KitPvp Server, i also just got accepted as a helper on a server named BattleMade and i also helped out with there Social medias, this is a much bigger server when the Factions reset is done it will get up to 70 players, ive also owned 2 servers and been a admin on another (all relatively small servers).


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?


 My Biggest Weakness would be trying to keep my punishments down admittedly i have made some mistakes but now I'm in my teen years and more mature then i was back when the punishments where made, ad cause you can't just take my word if i say ill never do anything bad again as I'm sure you've heard the many times, but i can assure you that i have matured so much more then when those punishments where taken.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader?


 Why/why not? I think a leader should be willing to take the shot for another and always be willing to help out no matter what, i feel after leading a team for almost a month 3-4 months I've learned that and I'm sure i can bring that into my moderating.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?


 Im incredibly active and popular over the community, a few may call me salty but i fell as if i have what it takes I've listened to what i was told last year ( Be More Active across discord and Forums) so I've done that in every way i could, i will keep trying till have what it takes and will always be determined.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? I feel you should be open minded to all sides of any arguments and be willing to speak with the younger side of the community with equal respect as you would to any others.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating? They should be very fair and listen ing to any points people have to make, stay calm and listen and wait till its your turn to make a choice and most of all be well cordenated with the other staff members.



CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?


 First id get evidence and see if what there doing is right or wrong and if its wrong id send it to a higher staff member or if its a admin id send it to another admin.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do? If it started to get that bad id record it and save it, id also disagrees the point when it gets to bad and politely argue my point how even though its allowed the should respect there staff team.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?


 First id PM them telling them to take it down and keep watching if its not taken down or he posts more id send it to another higher stamp member saying that id asked them to stop.



Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?


 If this was the case id check to see i fathers a admin thats not there ad tell them, I've also been tort some coding via keenan so we keep in touch and maybe as him what he thinks.



CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?


 I want to keep the server alive and keep cheaters away to allow the community to have  a good time online.


What does Avicus mean to you?


 i don't like to tell very many people but i have a few issues in real life, and when I'm feeling down i could go to hypixle for maybe 2 minutes and get board but i tent to go on advices and talk to the community they make me feel happy and at home.


Anything specific the staff team could do better? 


Except from activity and maybe some small tweaks hear and there where doing great. 


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?


 as i mentioned above i just love the server and the community, i know i have members like Rilo and Devon who dislike me but even when there being annoying i still come back to advices it attracts me and makes me feel at home and to be staff hear would be a dream come true.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?


 As i said before i was told last time that i needed to get more active so that is indeed what i did, i got more active on teamspeak, discord and the forums to the extend that i feel as if I'm ready to reapply. 


-Czco / Coco
